project: AI-Based Mobile Clinical Decision Support System for Delivery Outcome Prediction
task: Binary classification of delivery mode from intrapartum CTG and maternal data
target: Cesarean delivery (Deliv. type = 2) versus vaginal delivery (Deliv. type = 1)
prediction_time: During labour, using the most recent 30 minutes of CTG

dataset.name: CTU-CHB Intrapartum Cardiotocography Database, version 1.0.0
dataset.source: PhysioNet / Czech Technical University in Prague, University Hospital in Brno

multimodal.name: Multimodal 1D CNN + clinical MLP
multimodal.inputs: 4 x 1800 CTG tensor (FHR, UC, FHR mask, UC mask at 1 Hz) and 15 clinical features
multimodal.description: Four 1D convolution blocks (24-48-64-96 channels) with batch normalisation and pooling, concatenated average/max pooling, a 96-unit signal embedding, a 32-unit clinical embedding (48 hidden units), and a 64-unit fusion head.

signal.name: CTG-only 1D CNN
signal.description: The same signal encoder with a 48-unit classification head; ignores clinical inputs.

bilstm.name: CTG-only CNN-BiLSTM
bilstm.description: Three 1D convolution blocks (16-32-48 channels) with ReLU, batch normalisation and two max-pooling stages reduce the signal to 225 steps. A single-layer bidirectional LSTM (hidden size 32 per direction) models temporal dependencies, followed by dropout (0.30), a 32-unit fully connected layer, dropout (0.20) and a single output logit. Clinical inputs are ignored.

clinical.name: Clinical-only MLP
clinical.description: 32-unit clinical embedding and a 16-unit head; ignores the CTG input.

training.loss: Binary cross-entropy with positive-class weighting (negatives / positives)
training.regularisation: Dropout, batch normalisation, Gaussian input noise (sigma 0.03) on FHR/UC during training, gradient clipping at 5.0
training.model_selection: Early stopping on validation BCE loss (patience 15-20); the test split was never used
training.calibration: Platt scaling fitted on the validation split only
training.threshold_selection: Youden's J on the validation split only; applied unchanged to the test split

evaluation.threshold_policy: Probabilities are Platt-calibrated on the validation split. The decision threshold is the Youden-J optimum on the validation split and is applied unchanged to the test split. Both the 0.5 operating point and the validation-selected one are reported; moving the threshold trades sensitivity against specificity and is unstable with 7 validation events.

bilstm_vs_signal.interpretation: The paired bootstrap interval includes zero, so this experiment does not establish a statistically meaningful AUC difference between the CNN-BiLSTM and the 1D CNN.

limitations: Only 46 cesarean deliveries exist in the whole public dataset (506 vaginal); the held-out test set contains 7 cesarean records, so every performance estimate has very wide uncertainty.

The cohort is a selected subset of 552 recordings from a single Czech university hospital (the full CTU-CHB database contains 9164 recordings). Case mix, practice patterns and recording equipment differ elsewhere.

Cesarean recordings were released as a separate 46-case subset. Their raw recordings contain far more zero-coded FHR samples overall (32.9% vs 17.5%) and their usable length after trimming is shorter (58.4 vs 71.3 minutes); within the last 30-minute window, however, FHR missingness is lower for cesareans (9.3% vs 19.2%). Recording length and quality are therefore potential shortcuts. Duration itself is not an input, but missingness masks are, and this confound has not been eliminated.
Expert CTG annotations are not available in version 1.0.0 of this database, so the model learns the eventual mode of delivery, not an expert interpretation of fetal status.

Prevalence is 8.3%. Accuracy is dominated by the majority class; a majority-class classifier reaches 91.6% while detecting no cesareans. ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, sensitivity and specificity are the appropriate metrics.
No external, prospective or temporal validation has been performed. No calibration or threshold can be assumed to transfer to another hospital.
The clinical-only model did not discriminate better than chance on the held-out test set (ROC-AUC approximately 0.50); its score must not be read as a risk estimate.
Feature attributions are gradients of the model output with respect to its inputs. They describe model behaviour, not causal clinical mechanisms.
intended_use: Teaching and demonstration of an end-to-end clinical machine-learning workflow.
Research on multimodal intrapartum CTG and maternal-data modelling.
Reproducible benchmarking of deep learning against simple baselines on the public CTU-CHB intrapartum cardiotocography database.
prohibited_use: Any real clinical decision, triage, counselling or mode-of-delivery decision.
Use as a medical device, or as input to a device, without regulatory approval and prospective clinical validation.
Use on patient data without a lawful basis, ethics approval and appropriate data-protection safeguards.
Use of the demonstration records as if they were real patient cases.
disclaimer: Research prototype only. This output is a statistical estimate from a public research dataset and is not a diagnosis, a treatment recommendation, or a substitute for professional obstetric judgement. Do not use it to decide the mode of delivery.
